description.zh: 在一串图形中补出空缺的那一个：学前阶段是形状的重复单元，小学阶段是箭头按固定角度旋转。训练的是在形状与朝向两个视觉通道上识别序列规律。
description.en: Fill the one missing figure in a strip: in pre-school grades a repeating unit of shapes, in primary grades an arrow turning by a fixed angle. What it trains is recognising sequence rules on two visual channels — shape and orientation.

designModel.zh: K1-K2 是形状重复（单元 2 → 3 拍）；G1 换成旋转通道，箭头每次转 90 度（4 个朝向一轮）；G2 细化为 45 度（8 个朝向一轮），空格可能在中间。
designModel.en: K1-K2 repeat shapes (unit of 2, then 3 beats); G1 switches to the rotation channel with 90° turns (4 orientations per cycle); G2 refines to 45° turns (8 orientations per cycle) with the gap possibly mid-strip.

ageRange.noteZh: 形状交替 3-4 岁即可；45 度的细角度旋转约 7 岁。
ageRange.noteEn: Shape alternation suits ages 3-4; fine 45° rotation suits about age 7.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块属小精灵系列。与 learning/math/pattern 共用视觉序列规律能力，但 pattern 讲解规律结构；本模块不讲概念，只在形状与朝向通道上反复练习。与 spatial-pattern 的区别：后者是在地图上连续规划路径，本模块只判断单个图形的朝向变化。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module belongs to MindSeeds. It shares the visual-sequence ability with learning/math/pattern, but pattern explains rule structure; this module teaches no concept and drills the shape and orientation channels. Unlike spatial-pattern, which plans a continuous route on a map, this module only judges how a single figure's orientation changes.

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次 Attempt 上报 RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.SEQUENCE，不随等级变化。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every attempt reports RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.SEQUENCE, regardless of grade.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: shape 是不同形状按单元重复；rotation 是同一箭头按固定角度与方向旋转，干扰项包括转反、没转、翻转与多转一步。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: shape repeats distinct shapes in a unit; rotation turns one arrow by a fixed angle and direction, with distractors for turning the wrong way, not turning, flipping, and over-turning.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 一轮有几项：two 是 AB；three 是 AAB/ABB/ABC；four 是 90 度旋转的 4 个朝向；eight 是 45 度旋转的 8 个朝向。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: Items per cycle: two is AB; three is AAB/ABB/ABC; four is the four orientations of 90° turns; eight is the eight orientations of 45° turns.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: end 是『下一个是什么』；any 空格可能在中间，需要从两侧推断。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: end asks what comes next; any may put the gap mid-strip, requiring inference from both sides.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: K1 给 3 个选项，之后都是 4 个。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: K1 offers three options; later grades offer four.

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 6 题，通过线 75%（5/6）。没有静态题库：generator.js 现生成，玩完立即换一批。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Six items per run, passing at 75% (5/6). No static bank: generator.js builds each set and a new one is swapped in when the run ends.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 两种形状轮流出现（AB），补出下一个形状。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Two shapes alternate (AB); fill in the next shape.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 识别 3 拍的形状重复单元（AAB/ABB/ABC），补出下一个形状。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Recognise a 3-beat shape unit (AAB/ABB/ABC) and fill in the next shape.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 箭头每次顺时针或逆时针转 90 度，判断下一个朝向。
levelMap.objectiveEn: An arrow turns 90° clockwise or counterclockwise each time; judge the next orientation.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 箭头每次转 45 度，空格可能在中间，从两侧推断缺失的朝向。
levelMap.objectiveEn: An arrow turns 45° each time and the gap may be mid-strip; infer the missing orientation from both sides.

statistics.noteZh: 旋转题的 optionTypes（direction_reversed / no_turn / flipped / over_turned）能区分方向判断错与角度判断错。
statistics.noteEn: Rotation optionTypes (direction_reversed / no_turn / flipped / over_turned) distinguish a wrong direction from a wrong angle.
